body: On a computer this row holds one line of help; it also carries the way back after a jump, and on a phone the pen switch and Full screen. The plan keeps those and turns what the app has to say into short messages that leave by themselves: item ⑤ in `docs/design/app-layout.md`. Item ⑨ asks you whether you meant messages drawn by the app or the Mac's own notifications. Not built yet.
